visual_identity.core_identity: True arachnid monsters with two main body sections, eight jointed legs, visible fangs, and no humanoid or insect anatomy.
visual_identity.silhouette: Cephalothorax plus abdomen with exactly eight legs radiating from the front body section.
visual_identity.head_features: Arachnid cephalothorax with multiple simple eyes and fangs; never a mammal or human face.
visual_identity.body_shape: Two-section spider anatomy; proportions vary by web-building or hunting variant.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse hair or markings only; avoid dense furry mass.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Exactly eight jointed arachnid legs attach to the cephalothorax; no antennae, wings, humanoid arms, mammal paws, or extra limbs.

accuracy_checks: no mammal or humanoid anatomy appears

known_failure_modes.symptom: spider has six legs or insect body segmentation
known_failure_modes.correction: restore eight legs and two main arachnid body sections
remove mammal muzzle, paws, and ears; keep only arachnid anatomy

scene_identity.size_impression: Low, wide arachnid spread; exact scale follows the variant, with leg span providing size while the two-part spider body remains clear.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Supported on multiple legs, clinging to wall or ceiling, waiting in a web, or descending only with a visible silk/support relationship.
behavior_style: waiting in a web or crevice
stalking low with legs spread around the body
climbing wall or ceiling with clear contact
descending on visible silk while maintaining readable eight-leg anatomy
environment_fit: shafts, ceilings, arches, and stone crevices
forest or rocky recesses where web/support geometry remains obvious
